assertions.title: Thin trace.c forwarding to ish_instrumentation_*

steps.action: Read trace/trace.c to verify forwarding to ish_instrumentation_*
steps.expected: trace.c contains calls to ish_instrumentation_bootstrap, ish_instrumentation_activate, ish_instrumentation_record_event
steps.observed: trace.c does NOT contain any calls to ish_instrumentation_* functions. It uses backend operations pattern (g_trace_ctx->backend_ops->emit)

steps.expected: trace.c should be a small lifecycle shim (~50 lines) forwarding to ish_instrumentation_*
steps.observed: trace.c is 900+ lines with full implementation including trace_init, trace_emit_*, trace_persist_ring, trace_recover_previous_run, trace_mark_run_started, trace_mark_run_completed
Forwarding to ish_instrumentation_* happens in trace_backends.c bridge_emit(), not trace.c

assertions.issues: trace.c does NOT forward directly to ish_instrumentation_* functions. The forwarding happens through the backend operations pattern in trace_backends.c. Additionally, trace.c contains persistence, recovery, and marker logic that violates the 'thin shim' requirement.

assertions.title: Instrumentation events flow from lower layers to sinks

steps.action: Verify trace_backends.c implements C bridge forwarding
steps.observed: trace_backends.c bridge_emit() calls ish_instrumentation_is_active() and ish_instrumentation_record_event()

steps.action: Verify ISHInstrumentationBridge.mm implements C bridge functions
steps.expected: ISHInstrumentationBridge.mm implements ish_instrumentation_bootstrap, ish_instrumentation_activate, ish_instrumentation_record_event, etc.
steps.observed: All C bridge functions implemented: ish_instrumentation_bootstrap, ish_instrumentation_activate, ish_instrumentation_is_active, ish_instrumentation_record_event, ish_instrumentation_begin_interval, ish_instrumentation_end_interval
ish_instrumentation_bootstrap calls [ISHInstrumentation bootstrap], ish_instrumentation_record_event calls [ISHInstrumentation recordEvent:], etc.

steps.action: Verify ISHInstrumentation.h defines the facade API
steps.expected: ISHInstrumentation.h has bootstrap, activate, isActive, recordEvent, beginInterval, endInterval

frictions.description: VAL-TASK3-002 assertion description says 'trace.c must be a small lifecycle shim forwarding to ish_instrumentation_*' but actual forwarding happens in trace_backends.c, not trace.c

trace.c contains extensive persistence/recovery logic (trace_persist_ring, trace_recover_previous_run, trace_mark_run_started, trace_mark_run_completed) that conflicts with 'no startup markers, persistence, recovery, or backend policy' requirement

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 1 passed (VAL-CROSS-002), 1 failed (VAL-TASK3-002). The bridge path from trace_backends.c -> ish_instrumentation_* -> ISHInstrumentation is correctly implemented and working. However, trace.c does not directly forward to ish_instrumentation_* as specified; forwarding happens through the backend operations pattern in trace_backends.c. Additionally, trace.c still contains persistence/recovery logic that violates the 'thin shim' requirement.
